##### Project general facts

Lucky Royale is a contemporary residential development offering a diverse collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive three- and four-bedroom sky villas. The project combines modern architecture with sophisticated design, creating residences that emphasize space, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling windows, private terraces, and carefully planned layouts enhance the sense of openness, while the overall design reflects a balance between luxury, functionality, and contemporary urban living.

Residents have access to an extensive range of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and recreation. These include an infinity swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness studio, a sky lounge with water features, private terrace plunge pools, landscaped leisure areas, and retail facilities. The amenity offering creates a resort-inspired environment where residents can enjoy both active and leisurely pursuits within the comfort of the development.

The residences feature full modern finishing with high-quality materials, including European porcelain tiles. Interiors are designed with elegant detailing and contemporary finishes that complement the project's luxury positioning. Kitchens are fully equipped in a modern European style and seamlessly integrated into the living spaces. The residences are fitted with premium brands including Kludi bathroom fittings, Legrand electrical systems, and York air-conditioning systems, ensuring a high standard of quality and comfort throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
